passage.text: The pool is open every day from 6 a.m. to 8 p.m.
passage.reading: ðə ˈpuːl ɪz ˈoʊpən ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ frəm ˈsɪks ˌeɪˈɛm tə ˈeɪt ˌpiːˈɛm.

passage.text: Please take a shower before you swim.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈteɪk ə ˈʃaʊər bɪˈfɔːr juː ˈswɪm.

passage.text: No food or glass at the pool.
passage.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈfuːd ɔːr ˈɡlæs ət ðə ˈpuːl.

passage.text: Children under 12: please come with an adult.
passage.reading: ˈtʃɪldrən ˈʌndər ˈtwɛlv: ˈpliːz ˈkʌm wɪð ən əˈdʌlt.

passage.text: The lifeguard is on duty from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
passage.reading: ðə ˈlaɪfɡɑːrd ɪz ɑːn ˈduːti frəm ˈsɛvən ˌeɪˈɛm tə ˈsɛvən ˌpiːˈɛm.
